title: Baptized into Jesus in the Jordan
english: On the two and a half tribes who crossed the Jordan, on how the Lord exalted Jesus, and how he circumcised the people. Of those who crossed the Red Sea the Apostle says: [[All were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:2]]. Of those who crossed the Jordan we may say: all were baptized into Jesus in the Jordan — the form of baptism’s sacrament. [[The people hastened and crossed >> Bible:Joshua 4:10-11]] — so when we come to saving baptism we must not dawdle but hurry until we “cross” all that is commanded. To cross is to fulfill: [[Blessed are the poor in spirit >> Bible:Matthew 5:3]]; hunger for righteousness; mourn; become meek and peacemaking; bear persecutions with patience. Cross the Jordan with haste; afterward watch lest [[your steps almost slip >> Bible:Psalm 73:2]].

title: Forty thousand girded with truth
english: [[Forty thousand girded men crossed to fight before the Lord, to take Jericho >> Bible:Joshua 4:13]]. Who are the girded? Hear Paul: [[Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:14]]. If truth is our belt for Christ’s warfare, when a lie leaves our mouth we are ungirded from his service. It is not enough to seem truthful before people — truth must be kept [[in the Lord’s sight >> Bible:Joshua 4:13]], even what God sees in the heart. Of those who [[speak peace with their neighbor while evil is in their hearts >> Bible:Psalm 28:3]] — let the one who advances girded against Jericho be free of all that.

title: The battle after baptism is within
english: Crossing the Jordan we pass over into battles. What wars meet us after baptism? Learn from Paul: [[Our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, powers, the world-rulers of this darkness, the spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenlies >> Bible:Ephesians 6:12]]. [[These things happened to them as types and were written for us >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:11]]. Let us go out to war until the world’s first malice is stormed and sin’s proud walls fall. Look for no field outside yourself: the fight is within; [[from the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries >> Bible:Matthew 15:19]]. These must fall in the first clash; if we cut them down so none remains to breathe, Jesus will give that rest where [[each sits under his vine and fig tree >> Bible:Micah 4:4]].

title: Today I have rolled away Egypt’s reproach
english: [[Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you >> Bible:Joshua 5:9]] — the second circumcision at the hill of foreskins. The disobedient are called uncircumcised; what must be circumcised is not only idolatry but subtler vices. The Lord [[exalted Jesus in Israel’s sight >> Bible:Joshua 3:7; 4:14]] when he crossed the Jordan and circumcised the people. [[Manna ceased >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]; the land’s fruits are eaten. We who after baptism are freed from Egypt’s reproaches by the heart’s second circumcision enter the land of promise with Jesus as guide. To him be glory forever. Amen.
